product.name: Visa Application Centre Services
product.description: Outsourced support for submitting visa applications, including application intake, document handling, appointment coordination and passport return through VFS Global centres.

product.name: Biometric Collection Services
product.description: Collection and submission of applicant biometrics, such as fingerprints and photographs, for government visa and immigration applications.

product.name: Residence Permit Application Services
product.description: Administrative support for residence permit applications, including appointment handling, document intake, biometric collection and submission to government authorities.

identifier.value: Visa and Immigration Application Information Services

product.name: Visa and Immigration Application Information Services
product.description: Online and centre-based information that helps applicants identify requirements, select application locations, schedule appointments and prepare submissions.

product.name: Passport and Document Handling Services
product.description: Secure receipt, handling, transfer and return of passports and supporting documents submitted as part of visa or permit applications.

product.name: Citizen services
product.description: A planned VFS Global service offering intended to provide services to citizens.
